name: stack
description: Flexbox layout container for vertical or horizontal stacking with configurable gap, alignment, justification and wrapping — every group responsive on the canon breakpoint tiers

changes.note: A data-flex="1" or data-flex="auto" child now sets min-inline-size: 0. The flex default (auto) kept a growing child at least as wide as its content, so a wide table or an unbreakable id inside it widened the whole row past its container; the child now takes the space it is given and the content scrolls or wraps in its own box. data-flex="none" is content-sized by design and is unchanged. A child that relied on never being narrower than its content can set min-inline-size itself.

BREAKING: direction moves from data-variant to data-direction. data-variant="horizontal" is a deprecated 0.x alias — it selects exactly the same CSS rules and keeps working through 0.x, and is removed in 1.0. The move is what makes direction responsive: the responsive grammar (data-<attr>-<tier>) may not suffix the five frozen protocol attributes, so data-variant-md could never exist. Migration: data-variant="horizontal" → data-direction="horizontal"; data-responsive (also deprecated, also removed in 1.0) → data-direction="vertical" data-direction-sm="horizontal", which reads mobile-first. The deprecated collapse no longer forces align-items: stretch below sm, so a stack that sets data-align keeps its alignment in the collapsed column. Newly declared, previously undeclared in the manifest but always present in the CSS: data-justify, data-wrap, data-align-text, child data-flex, gaps 10|12|16 and align baseline.

wrap.description: Bare `data-wrap` lets children reflow onto new lines (flex-wrap: wrap). Intrinsic — prefer it to a breakpoint whenever a row only needs to fit.

align-text.description: Text alignment for the whole stack. Logical: `right` maps to text-align: end, so it flips under RTL.

flex.description: Written on a CHILD of the stack, never the root: `1` grows to fill, `auto` sizes to content then grows, `none` freezes the child at its base size.

responsive.description: Deprecated 0.x collapse: a horizontal stack stays a column below the sm tier. Superseded by data-direction="vertical" data-direction-sm="horizontal"; removed in 1.0.

a11y.notes: Layout-only primitive; no semantic role required
